hw_name.description: Extra functions added by the RFP build.

basic_duty_enable.description: Duty control: when the requested duty drops below the present duty, the motor is released: no braking and no acceleration (zero current, the bridge stays on) until the duty falls to the request, then it follows it again. Off: the Duty Downramp regulator brakes to follow a falling request.

hybrid_enable.description: Forward requests: the duty is limited proportionally to the throttle, so half throttle gives half torque and, without load, about half speed. Duty limit = throttle x Duty Limit at Full Throttle x Maximum Duty Cycle. The current decreases linearly over the Current Taper Band below the limit and is zero at the limit. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

hybrid_duty_limit.description: Duty limit at full throttle, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

hybrid_band.description: Part of the duty limit over which the current decreases to zero.

braking_reverse_enable.description: On: the Braking and Reverse settings below apply to reverse requests (negative relative current). Off: official behaviour (negative current, then reverse at full current). Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

braking_mode.description: Reverse request while rolling forward faster than Stop ERPM. Active: negative current as in the official firmware: torque against the motion, current injected from the battery when regeneration is not enough, down to Stop ERPM. Regen Only: brake current (as the No Reverse control types): regeneration only, phases shorted when the current cannot be held. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

reverse_mode.description: Reverse request below Stop ERPM (stopped or already reversing). Current: reverse in current, limited by the Reverse Current settings (100 % = official firmware). None: never reverse, zero current. Duty: reverse in duty proportional to the request, up to Reverse Duty Max. Smart: reverse in current with a duty limit proportional to the request, raised with a ramp. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

stop_erpm.description: Below this speed the vehicle is considered stopped: end of braking, start of the reverse handling. Sensorless motors: keep a few hundred ERPM (speed reading is noisy near standstill).

stop_hyst.description: Once reversing (below Stop ERPM), braking resumes only above Stop ERPM x (1 + this value). Avoids switching back and forth around Stop ERPM.

rev_transition.description: Time over which the current moves from the braking value to the reverse value (and back), instead of a sudden change of sign. 0 = immediate.

brake_taper_start_erpm.description: Active braking: below this speed the braking current decreases, down to Braking Taper Min at Stop ERPM. Limits the overshoot into reverse.

brake_taper_min.description: Active braking: fraction of the braking current kept at Stop ERPM. 100 % = no reduction (official).

rev_cur_max.description: Reverse = Current: reverse current at full request, as a fraction of the motor current limit.

rev_cur_duty_max.description: Reverse = Current: duty limit in reverse (top reverse speed), as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle. The current decreases over the Reverse Taper Band below it. 100 % = no limit.

rev_band.description: Reverse = Current or Smart: part of the reverse duty limit over which the current decreases to zero.

rev_duty_max.description: Reverse = Duty: duty at full reverse request, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

smart_cur_max.description: Reverse = Smart: reverse current at full request, as a fraction of the motor current limit.

smart_duty_max.description: Reverse = Smart: duty limit at full reverse request, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

smart_ramp.description: Reverse = Smart: time to raise the duty limit from 0 to Smart Reverse Duty Max.

smart_repress.description: Reverse = Smart: after braking to a stop, return to neutral and request reverse again to start reversing.

tractor_enable.description: On: the throttle (relative current request) drives the tractor spring below instead of the motor current. Off: normal operation. Applies to relative current requests: ADC and PPM apps, VESC Remote, PAS, CAN. The VESC Tool keyboard (absolute current) is not affected.

tractor_mode.description: Virtual spring on the wheel position (tachometer). An anchor position is held with zero throttle and moves with the throttle. Within Freedom of the anchor the motor is free; beyond, a force proportional to the distance pulls the wheel back (Stiffness). Brake opposes the free motion. For stairs, mud... Spring Current: output in current. Spring Duty: output in duty (to try). Any other command (brake, duty, keyboard, timeout) stops the tractor at once.

tractor_speed_mode.description: Throttle: anchor speed proportional to the throttle, up to Tractor Max ERPM. Preset: the anchor moves at Tractor Max ERPM as soon as the throttle is pressed (direction given by its sign).

tractor_max_erpm.description: Anchor speed at full throttle (or the preset speed).

tractor_freedom.description: Free play around the anchor, in electrical degrees (the tachometer counts 60 degree steps).

tractor_stiffness.description: Spring Current: current per electrical degree beyond Freedom.

tractor_brake.description: Spring Current: current against the speed difference to the anchor, per 1000 ERPM.

tractor_max_current.description: Spring Current: current limit (also capped by the motor limit).

tractor_max_lag.description: Largest distance between the wheel and the anchor, in electrical degrees. When the wheel is blocked the anchor stops moving away beyond it (no huge pull when it frees).

tractor_duty_stiffness.description: Spring Duty: duty per electrical degree beyond Freedom.

tractor_duty_brake.description: Spring Duty: duty against the speed difference to the anchor, per 1000 ERPM.

tractor_max_duty.description: Spring Duty: duty limit, as a fraction of Maximum Duty Cycle.

adc_ctrl_type.description: Replaces the Control Type of the ADC app (App to Use = ADC); all the other ADC app settings (voltages, filter, deadband, throttle curves, ramps, safe start, cruise button, multiple ESCs, traction control) still apply. App ADC Setting: the Control Type of the ADC app is used. Current Signed, Brake Priority: ADC1 = forward, ADC2 = reverse, sent as a signed relative current (-100 % to +100 %), so the Braking / Reverse settings handle ADC2. When ADC2 is pressed (above the ADC app deadband) ADC1 is ignored. ADC1 uses the linear mapping (Start / End voltages, no center).
